Building Science & Manufacturer Technical Guidance (4 Non-Video Sources) 6. **Building Science Corporation (BSC) — BSD-149:** *"Unvented Roof Assemblies for All Climates"* by Christopher Schumacher - **URL:** `https://buildingscience.com/documents/digests/bsd-149-unvented-roof-assemblies-for-all-climates` - **Core Guidance:** Analyzes unvented roof physics. Closed-cell spray polyurethane foam (ccSPF) acts as an air barrier at a minimum 1" thickness and as a Class II vapor retarder at a minimum 2" thickness (<1.0 perm). Practical Recommendation for a 10x12 Climate-Controlled Shed For a standard 10x12 outbuilding (120 sq. ft. floor, ~320 net sq. ft. walls, ~150 sq. ft. roof/ceiling), the ideal year-round climate-controlled assembly that balances thermal resistance, airtightness, acoustic isolation, and DIY buildability is **Strategy 2 (Mineral Wool + Rigid Foam Hybrid)**. ### A. Recommended Wall Assembly - **Framing:** Standard 2x4 framing at 16" on-center. - **Exterior Weather Barrier:** Exterior sheathing (OSB or plywood) wrapped with a water-resistive barrier (DuPont Tyvek HomeWrap) with taped seams, behind standard siding on rainscreen furring strips (or direct-applied siding). - **Cavity Insulation:** **ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt R-15** (3.5" thickness, 15" width). Friction-fit firmly between studs with no gaps or compression. - **Interior Finish:** 1/2" drywall (taped and primed with vapor-retardant latex paint) or 1/2" interior plywood. An interior 6-mil poly sheet should be **omitted** to prevent a double vapor barrier that traps summer humidity. ### B. Recommended Roof / Ceiling Assembly - **Framing:** 2x6 roof rafters at 16" or 24" on-center. - **Ventilation:** Continuous vented soffit at the eaves connected to upper gable louvers or a continuous ridge vent. Install **Amerimax Accuvent** baffles (or Durovent) in every rafter bay against the roof deck to guarantee a 1" to 1.5" continuous air channel. - **Cavity Insulation:** **ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt R-15** installed below the baffles within the rafter bays. - **Continuous Thermal Break & Air Barrier:** **2" Owens Corning FOAMULAR NGX F-250 XPS (R-10)** panels fastened directly across the underside of the rafters using 3" construction screws through 1.25" Go Board / plastic insulation washers. - **Air Sealing:** Seal all board perimeter perimeters and penetrations with low-expansion Great Stuff Pro Window & Door polyurethane foam, and tape all board butt-joints with DuPont Tyvek Acrylic Construction Tape. This creates an airtight, continuous interior ceiling plane providing **R-25 total resistance** and completely stopping warm, humid indoor air from reaching the cold roof deck. ### C. Recommended Floor Assembly - **Sub-Base:** Ground cleared and sloped away from the shed, covered with a heavy **6-mil polyethylene sheet** ballasted with gravel to stop rising ground moisture. Pier blocks or skids elevate the shed floor framing at least 6" off the ground for cross-ventilation. - **Framing:** Pressure-treated 2x6 floor joists at 16" on-center. - **Insulation:** **2" Owens Corning FOAMULAR NGX XPS (R-10)** rigid foam boards cut to width and friction-fitted between the joists, supported by 1x2 ledger strips or corrosion-resistant screws. Seal all perimeter gaps between foam and joists with canned expanding foam to block air infiltration and rodent intrusion. - **Subfloor:** 3/4" tongue-and-groove exterior-grade OSB or plywood glued to the joists with subfloor construction adhesive (e.g., Liquid Nails) and screwed down. - **Finished Floor:** Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) with integrated waterproof underlayment. ### D. Climate Control Pairing Pair this tight envelope with an appropriately sized **9,000 BTU mini-split heat pump** (or a dual-hose inverter window heat pump). In a 120 sq. ft. space with an R-15/R-25/R-10 envelope, a mini-split will operate at minimum modulation, maintain exact workspace temperatures in sub-freezing winters or hot summers, and actively dehumidify the air to eliminate indoor moisture accumulation. --- ## 4. Delivers exceptional thermal and acoustic comfort, eliminates thermal bridging, prevents condensation without fragile poly sheets, and is 100% buildable with basic DIY hand tools.* 2. **Best Budget Option: Strategy 1 (Traditional Vented Fiberglass Batts)** *At ~$584 in total materials, it is the lowest initial outlay. However, it requires flawless air sealing, pristine soffit-to-ridge venting baffles, and vigilance against rodent nesting and interstitial moisture degradation.* 3. **Option to Avoid: Strategy 3 (DIY Closed-Cell Spray Foam Kits)** *Avoid unless extreme space constraints necessitate maximum R/inch (R-6.2/in) or unvented complex framing prevents baffles. Practical Recommendation for a 10x12 Climate-Controlled Shed For a standard 10x12 outbuilding (120 sq. ft. floor, ~320 net sq. ft. walls, ~150 sq. ft. roof/ceiling), the ideal year-round climate-controlled assembly that balances thermal resistance, airtightness, acoustic isolation, and DIY buildability is **Strategy 2 (Mineral Wool + Rigid Foam Hybrid)**. ### A. Recommended Wall Assembly - **Framing:** Standard 2x4 framing at 16" on-center. - **Exterior Weather Barrier:** Exterior sheathing (OSB or plywood) wrapped with a water-resistive barrier (DuPont Tyvek HomeWrap) with taped seams, behind standard siding on rainscreen furring strips (or direct-applied siding). - **Cavity Insulation:** **ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt R-15** (3.5" thickness, 15" width). Friction-fit firmly between studs with no gaps or compression. - **Interior Finish:** 1/2" drywall (taped and primed with vapor-retardant latex paint) or 1/2" interior plywood. An interior 6-mil poly sheet should be **omitted** to prevent a double vapor barrier that traps summer humidity. ### B. Recommended Roof / Ceiling Assembly - **Framing:** 2x6 roof rafters at 16" or 24" on-center. - **Ventilation:** Continuous vented soffit at the eaves connected to upper gable louvers or a continuous ridge vent. Install **Amerimax Accuvent** baffles (or Durovent) in every rafter bay against the roof deck to guarantee a 1" to 1.5" continuous air channel. - **Cavity Insulation:** **ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt R-15** installed below the baffles within the rafter bays. - **Continuous Thermal Break & Air Barrier:** **2" Owens Corning FOAMULAR NGX F-250 XPS (R-10)** panels fastened directly across the underside of the rafters using 3" construction screws through 1.25" Go Board / plastic insulation washers. - **Air Sealing:** Seal all board perimeter perimeters and penetrations with low-expansion Great Stuff Pro Window & Door polyurethane foam, and tape all board butt-joints with DuPont Tyvek Acrylic Construction Tape. This creates an airtight, continuous interior ceiling plane providing **R-25 total resistance** and completely stopping warm, humid indoor air from reaching the cold roof deck. ### C. Recommended Floor Assembly - **Sub-Base:** Ground cleared and sloped away from the shed, covered with a heavy **6-mil polyethylene sheet** ballasted with gravel to stop rising ground moisture. Pier blocks or skids elevate the shed floor framing at least 6" off the ground for cross-ventilation. - **Framing:** Pressure-treated 2x6 floor joists at 16" on-center. - **Insulation:** **2" Owens Corning FOAMULAR NGX XPS (R-10)** rigid foam boards cut to width and friction-fitted between the joists, supported by 1x2 ledger strips or corrosion-resistant screws. Seal all perimeter gaps between foam and joists with canned expanding foam to block air infiltration and rodent intrusion. - **Subfloor:** 3/4" tongue-and-groove exterior-grade OSB or plywood glued to the joists with subfloor construction adhesive (e.g., Liquid Nails) and screwed down. - **Finished Floor:** Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) with integrated waterproof underlayment. ### D. Climate Control Pairing Pair this tight envelope with an appropriately sized **9,000 BTU mini-split heat pump** (or a dual-hose inverter window heat pump). In a 120 sq. ft. space with an R-15/R-25/R-10 envelope, a mini-split will operate at minimum modulation, maintain exact workspace temperatures in sub-freezing winters or hot summers, and actively dehumidify the air to eliminate indoor moisture accumulation. --- ## 4.
